pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī bahussutā hoti bhāṇikā visāradā paṭṭā dhammiṃ kathaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.4: tena kho pana samayena thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā pariveṇaṃ uddriyati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.8: atha kho te manussā thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā pariveṇatthāya chandakaṃ saṃharitvā thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā parikkhāraṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.9: thullanandā bhikkhunī tena ca parikkhārena sayampi yācitvā bhesajjaṃ cetāpetvā paribhuñji.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.11: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessatī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.12: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.17: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:1.18.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.8: ekāya bhikkhuniyā na saṅghassa na gaṇassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.12: yaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ cetāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.14: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.17: “idaṃ me ayye aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajāmī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.21.1: aññadatthike aññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.22: aññadatthike vematikā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np10:2.23: aññadatthike anaññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
